title: Gaussian Pyramid
text: Perform Gaussian pyramid decomposition, 1 input, 1 output; {Operation} selects operation, {Pyramid level} sets the image scaling factor, {Coefficient source} sets the lowpass filter coefficient source Default separable filter, {Coefficients for separable filter} sets the separable filter coefficient and {Hidden coefficients} sets the hidden separable filter coefficients. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: I
ports.summary: Input image scalar | vector | matrix | array

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Output image scalar | vector | matrix | array

params.name: Coefficient source
params.values: Lowpass filter coefficient source Default separable filter [1/4-a/2 1/4 a 1/4 1/4-a/2] (default) | Specify via dialog
